raw.en: Turn data and AI into operating results you can measure.
raw.th: เปลี่ยนข้อมูลและ AI ให้เป็นผลลัพธ์การดำเนินงานที่วัดผลได้

text.vi: MindKite Labs — Tư vấn chuyển đổi số, dữ liệu và AI
text.en: MindKite Labs — Digital transformation, data and AI consulting
text.th: MindKite Labs — ที่ปรึกษาด้านการเปลี่ยนผ่านสู่ดิจิทัล ข้อมูล และ AI

text.vi: MindKite Labs tư vấn chuyển đổi số, dữ liệu, AI ứng dụng, quy trình vận hành và chuyển đổi số giáo dục cho doanh nghiệp và tổ chức giáo dục Việt Nam, với KPI đo được ở từng giai đoạn.
text.en: MindKite Labs advises businesses and education organizations in Vietnam and Southeast Asia on digital transformation, data, applied AI, operating processes and education technology, with measurable KPIs at every stage.
text.th: MindKite Labs ให้คำปรึกษาด้านการเปลี่ยนผ่านสู่ดิจิทัล ข้อมูล AI ประยุกต์ กระบวนการดำเนินงาน และเทคโนโลยีการศึกษา สำหรับธุรกิจและองค์กรการศึกษาในเวียดนามและเอเชียตะวันออกเฉียงใต้ พร้อม KPI ที่วัดผลได้ในทุกขั้นตอน

text.vi: MindKite Labs đồng hành cùng doanh nghiệp và nhà trường Việt Nam: chuẩn hoá quy trình, xây nền tảng dữ liệu và đưa AI vào công việc hằng ngày, với KPI rõ ràng ở từng giai đoạn.
text.en: MindKite Labs works alongside businesses and schools in Vietnam and Southeast Asia to standardize processes, build a solid data foundation and bring AI into everyday work, with clear KPIs at every stage.
text.th: MindKite Labs ทำงานร่วมกับธุรกิจและสถานศึกษาในเวียดนามและเอเชียตะวันออกเฉียงใต้ เพื่อจัดระบบกระบวนการ วางรากฐานข้อมูล และนำ AI มาใช้ในงานประจำวัน พร้อม KPI ที่ชัดเจนในทุกขั้นตอน

text.th: เส้นทางการเปลี่ยนผ่านจากปัจจุบัน ผ่านกระบวนการ ข้อมูล และ AI สู่เป้าหมาย

text.vi: Số liệu mỗi phòng một kiểu, họp giao ban mất nửa buổi để thống nhất con số.
text.en: Every department reports different numbers, and weekly meetings spend half the time agreeing on them.
text.th: แต่ละแผนกมีตัวเลขไม่ตรงกัน การประชุมเสียเวลาครึ่งหนึ่งไปกับการกระทบยอดตัวเลข

text.vi: Phê duyệt chi, đơn hàng, nghỉ phép nằm rải rác trong nhiều nhóm chat.
text.en: Expense, order and leave approvals are scattered across chat groups.
text.th: การอนุมัติค่าใช้จ่าย คำสั่งซื้อ และการลา กระจัดกระจายอยู่ในหลายกลุ่มแชต

text.vi: Báo cáo cuối ngày phải tổng hợp tay từ Excel, POS và sàn thương mại điện tử.
text.en: End-of-day reports are compiled by hand from Excel, POS and e-commerce platforms.
text.th: รายงานสิ้นวันต้องรวบรวมด้วยมือจาก Excel ระบบ POS และแพลตฟอร์มอีคอมเมิร์ซ

text.vi: Đã thử công cụ AI nhưng chưa biết đưa vào việc nào, đo hiệu quả ra sao.
text.en: You have tried AI tools but are unsure where they fit or how to measure the impact.
text.th: เคยลองใช้เครื่องมือ AI แต่ยังไม่รู้ว่าควรใช้กับงานไหนและจะวัดผลอย่างไร

text.vi: Về chúng tôi
text.th: เกี่ยวกับเรา

text.vi: Giúp doanh nghiệp và nhà trường cất cánh bằng dữ liệu và AI.
text.en: Helping businesses and schools take off with data and AI.
text.th: ช่วยให้ธุรกิจและสถานศึกษาทะยานขึ้นด้วยข้อมูลและ AI

text.vi: MindKite Labs tư vấn và xây dựng giải pháp chuyển đổi số, dữ liệu và AI ứng dụng cho doanh nghiệp vừa và nhỏ cùng các tổ chức giáo dục tại Việt Nam. Chúng tôi làm việc trực tiếp với người vận hành, bắt đầu từ bài toán thật và đo kết quả bằng số liệu.
text.en: MindKite Labs advises on and builds digital transformation, data and applied AI solutions for small and mid-sized businesses and education organizations in Vietnam and Southeast Asia. We work directly with the people who run operations, start from real problems and measure results in numbers.
text.th: MindKite Labs ให้คำปรึกษาและพัฒนาโซลูชันด้านการเปลี่ยนผ่านสู่ดิจิทัล ข้อมูล และ AI ประยุกต์ สำหรับธุรกิจขนาดกลางและขนาดย่อม รวมถึงองค์กรการศึกษาในเวียดนามและเอเชียตะวันออกเฉียงใต้ เราทำงานโดยตรงกับผู้ที่ดูแลงานจริง เริ่มจากโจทย์จริง และวัดผลด้วยตัวเลข

text.vi: Ý nghĩa tên gọi
text.th: ความหมายของชื่อ

text.vi: Tư duy
text.th: วิธีคิด

text.vi: Mọi thay đổi bắt đầu từ cách con người suy nghĩ và làm việc. Công nghệ chỉ phát huy giá trị khi phục vụ đúng tư duy và đúng con người.
text.en: Every change starts with how people think and work. Technology only creates value when it serves the right thinking and the right people.
text.th: ทุกการเปลี่ยนแปลงเริ่มจากวิธีคิดและวิธีทำงานของคน เทคโนโลยีจะสร้างคุณค่าได้ก็ต่อเมื่อรับใช้วิธีคิดที่ถูกต้องและคนที่ใช่

text.vi: Cánh diều
text.th: ว่าว

text.vi: Diều bay cao nhờ có gió và một sợi dây giữ chắc. Dữ liệu và AI là gió; quy trình rõ ràng là sợi dây. Thiếu dây, diều không thể bay lên.
text.en: A kite rises with the wind and a string that holds it steady. Data and AI are the wind; clear processes are the string. Without the string, the kite cannot fly.
text.th: ว่าวลอยสูงได้เพราะมีลมและมีเชือกที่ยึดไว้อย่างมั่นคง ข้อมูลและ AI คือสายลม กระบวนการที่ชัดเจนคือเชือก หากไม่มีเชือก ว่าวก็บินขึ้นไม่ได้

text.vi: Phòng thực nghiệm
text.th: ห้องทดลอง

text.vi: Thử nhỏ, đo lường, rồi mới mở rộng. Mỗi giải pháp đều được kiểm chứng trên dữ liệu thật trước khi triển khai cho toàn tổ chức.
text.en: Start small, measure, then scale. Every solution is proven on real data before it is rolled out across the organization.
text.th: เริ่มเล็ก วัดผล แล้วจึงขยาย ทุกโซลูชันได้รับการพิสูจน์กับข้อมูลจริงก่อนนำไปใช้ทั้งองค์กร

text.vi: Sứ mệnh
text.th: พันธกิจ

text.vi: Đưa dữ liệu và AI vào vận hành một cách thực tế.
text.en: Bring data and AI into operations, practically.
text.th: นำข้อมูลและ AI เข้าสู่การดำเนินงานอย่างใช้ได้จริง

text.vi: Giúp doanh nghiệp và nhà trường Việt Nam ứng dụng dữ liệu và AI vào công việc hằng ngày: đo lường được hiệu quả, tự vận hành được sau bàn giao và không phụ thuộc vào một nhà cung cấp.
text.en: Help businesses and schools apply data and AI to everyday work, with measurable impact, the ability to run it themselves after handover, and no dependence on a single vendor.
text.th: ช่วยให้ธุรกิจและสถานศึกษานำข้อมูลและ AI มาใช้ในงานประจำวัน โดยวัดผลได้ ดูแลระบบเองได้หลังการส่งมอบ และไม่ต้องพึ่งพาผู้ให้บริการรายใดรายหนึ่ง

text.vi: Tầm nhìn
text.th: วิสัยทัศน์

text.vi: Mỗi quyết định quan trọng đều dựa trên dữ liệu.
text.en: Every important decision is backed by data.
text.th: ทุกการตัดสินใจสำคัญมีข้อมูลรองรับ

text.vi: Trở thành đối tác chuyển đổi số tin cậy của doanh nghiệp vừa và nhỏ và các tổ chức giáo dục tại Việt Nam, nơi con người được giải phóng khỏi việc lặp lại để tập trung vào việc tạo ra giá trị.
text.en: To be the trusted digital transformation partner for small and mid-sized businesses and education organizations in Vietnam and Southeast Asia, where people are freed from repetitive work to focus on creating value.
text.th: เป็นพันธมิตรด้านการเปลี่ยนผ่านสู่ดิจิทัลที่ไว้วางใจได้ของธุรกิจขนาดกลางและขนาดย่อม และองค์กรการศึกษาในเวียดนามและเอเชียตะวันออกเฉียงใต้ ที่ซึ่งผู้คนเป็นอิสระจากงานซ้ำซากเพื่อมุ่งสร้างคุณค่า

text.vi: Năm năng lực, một mục tiêu: tổ chức vận hành nhanh và chính xác hơn.
text.en: Five capabilities, one goal: an organization that runs faster and more accurately.
text.th: ห้าความสามารถ หนึ่งเป้าหมาย: องค์กรที่ทำงานได้เร็วและแม่นยำยิ่งขึ้น

text.vi: Chuyển đổi số
text.th: การเปลี่ยนผ่านสู่ดิจิทัล

text.vi: Xây lộ trình theo mức độ sẵn sàng thực tế, chọn công cụ phù hợp ngân sách và ưu tiên tận dụng hệ thống đang có.
text.en: Build a roadmap based on real readiness, choose tools that fit the budget and make the most of existing systems.
text.th: วางโรดแมปตามความพร้อมจริง เลือกเครื่องมือให้เหมาะกับงบประมาณ และใช้ระบบที่มีอยู่ให้คุ้มค่าที่สุด

text.vi: Ví dụ bài toán:
text.th: ตัวอย่างโจทย์:

text.vi: gom các luồng duyệt chi đang nằm trong nhóm chat về một quy trình phê duyệt có lịch sử và hạn xử lý.
text.en: move expense approvals out of chat groups into one approval flow with history and deadlines.
text.th: ย้ายการอนุมัติค่าใช้จ่ายจากกลุ่มแชตมาไว้ในขั้นตอนอนุมัติเดียวที่มีประวัติและกำหนดเวลา

text.vi: Đánh giá mức độ trưởng thành số
text.th: ประเมินระดับความพร้อมด้านดิจิทัล

text.vi: Lộ trình 6–18 tháng theo giai đoạn
text.th: โรดแมป 6–18 เดือนแบบเป็นระยะ

text.vi: Số hoá biểu mẫu, phê duyệt, hồ sơ
text.th: แปลงแบบฟอร์ม การอนุมัติ และเอกสารเป็นดิจิทัล

text.vi: Tư vấn lựa chọn phần mềm độc lập
text.th: คำแนะนำการเลือกซอฟต์แวร์อย่างเป็นกลาง

text.vi: Dữ liệu & BI
text.th: ข้อมูลและ BI

text.vi: Thống nhất định nghĩa chỉ số, gom dữ liệu từ nhiều nguồn về một nơi và dựng dashboard mà ban điều hành thực sự dùng mỗi sáng.
text.en: Agree on metric definitions, bring data from many sources into one place and build dashboards leadership actually uses every morning.
text.th: กำหนดนิยามตัวชี้วัดให้ตรงกัน รวมข้อมูลจากหลายแหล่งไว้ที่เดียว และสร้างแดชบอร์ดที่ผู้บริหารใช้จริงทุกเช้า

text.vi: báo cáo doanh thu, tồn kho cuối ngày tự cập nhật thay vì kế toán tổng hợp tay đến tối.
text.en: end-of-day revenue and inventory reports that update automatically instead of being compiled by hand late into the evening.
text.th: รายงานยอดขายและสินค้าคงคลังสิ้นวันที่อัปเดตอัตโนมัติ แทนการรวบรวมด้วยมือจนถึงค่ำ

text.vi: Từ điển chỉ số (KPI dictionary)
text.th: พจนานุกรม KPI

text.vi: Kho dữ liệu và pipeline tự động
text.th: คลังข้อมูลและ pipeline อัตโนมัติ

text.vi: Dashboard điều hành, bán hàng, vận hành
text.th: แดชบอร์ดผู้บริหาร การขาย และการดำเนินงาน

text.vi: Quản trị chất lượng và phân quyền dữ liệu
text.th: การกำกับคุณภาพข้อมูลและสิทธิ์การเข้าถึง

text.vi: AI ứng dụng
text.th: AI ประยุกต์

text.vi: Chọn đúng việc để AI làm, có người kiểm duyệt và đo được sai số. Không triển khai AI chỉ để có AI.
text.en: Pick the right work for AI, keep a human reviewer and measure the error rate. No AI just for the sake of AI.
text.th: เลือกงานที่เหมาะกับ AI มีคนตรวจทาน และวัดอัตราความผิดพลาดได้ ไม่ใช้ AI เพียงเพื่อให้มี AI

text.vi: trợ lý tra cứu chính sách, quy trình nội bộ cho nhân viên mới, trả lời kèm trích dẫn tài liệu gốc.
text.en: an assistant that answers new staff questions on internal policies and procedures, with citations to the source documents.
text.th: ผู้ช่วยตอบคำถามพนักงานใหม่เรื่องนโยบายและขั้นตอนภายใน พร้อมอ้างอิงเอกสารต้นฉบับ

text.vi: Sàng lọc và xếp hạng use case AI
text.en: AI use case screening and prioritization
text.th: คัดกรองและจัดลำดับ use case ของ AI

text.vi: Trợ lý tri thức nội bộ
text.th: ผู้ช่วยความรู้ภายในองค์กร

text.vi: Trích xuất chứng từ, phân loại phản hồi
text.th: ดึงข้อมูลจากเอกสารและจัดหมวดหมู่ความคิดเห็น

text.vi: Dự báo nhu cầu, tồn kho
text.th: พยากรณ์ความต้องการและสินค้าคงคลัง

text.vi: Quy trình vận hành
text.th: กระบวนการดำเนินงาน

text.vi: Viết rõ quy trình trước khi tự động hoá. Ai làm, làm khi nào, đo bằng gì — để hệ thống không phụ thuộc vào một vài cá nhân.
text.en: Write the process down before automating it: who does what, when, and how it is measured, so the system does not depend on a few individuals.
text.th: เขียนกระบวนการให้ชัดก่อนทำระบบอัตโนมัติ ใครทำ ทำเมื่อไร และวัดด้วยอะไร เพื่อให้ระบบไม่ต้องพึ่งพาคนเพียงไม่กี่คน

text.vi: chuẩn hoá quy trình nhận đơn đến giao hàng, gắn KPI thời gian xử lý cho từng khâu.
text.en: standardize the order-to-delivery process and attach a processing-time KPI to each step.
text.th: จัดมาตรฐานกระบวนการตั้งแต่รับคำสั่งซื้อจนถึงจัดส่ง และกำหนด KPI เวลาดำเนินการของแต่ละขั้น

text.vi: Đồng hành cùng trường học, trung tâm đào tạo và bộ phận đào tạo nội bộ doanh nghiệp: số hoá vận hành học vụ, khai thác dữ liệu học tập và đưa AI vào giảng dạy có kiểm soát.
text.en: We work with schools, training centers and corporate learning teams to digitize academic operations, make use of learning data and bring AI into teaching with proper oversight.
text.th: ทำงานร่วมกับโรงเรียน ศูนย์ฝึกอบรม และทีมพัฒนาบุคลากรในองค์กร เพื่อแปลงงานวิชาการเป็นดิจิทัล ใช้ประโยชน์จากข้อมูลการเรียน และนำ AI มาใช้ในการสอนอย่างมีการควบคุม

text.vi: theo dõi chuyên cần và kết quả học tập trên một dashboard, cảnh báo sớm học viên có nguy cơ bỏ học để giáo viên kịp hỗ trợ.
text.en: track attendance and learning results on one dashboard and flag at-risk learners early so teachers can step in.
text.th: ติดตามการเข้าเรียนและผลการเรียนบนแดชบอร์ดเดียว และแจ้งเตือนผู้เรียนที่เสี่ยงจะออกกลางคันตั้งแต่เนิ่น ๆ เพื่อให้ครูช่วยเหลือได้ทัน

text.en: Digital admissions, academic records and tuition
text.th: ระบบรับสมัคร งานทะเบียน และค่าเล่าเรียนแบบดิจิทัล

text.en: AI assistants for lesson planning and grading, with teacher review
text.th: ผู้ช่วย AI สำหรับเตรียมการสอนและตรวจงาน โดยมีครูตรวจทาน

text.en: Digital and AI skills training for staff

text.en: Seven steps, one closed loop. It ends with measurement, not handover.
text.th: เจ็ดขั้นตอน หนึ่งวงจรต่อเนื่อง จบด้วยการวัดผล ไม่ใช่แค่การส่งมอบ

text.vi: Mỗi bước có đầu ra cụ thể để doanh nghiệp duyệt trước khi đi tiếp.
text.en: Each step has concrete deliverables for you to approve before moving on.
text.th: ทุกขั้นตอนมีผลลัพธ์ที่ชัดเจนให้คุณอนุมัติก่อนไปขั้นถัดไป

Ý tưởng — khảo sát và định nghĩa bài toán
text.en: Ideation — research and define the problem
text.th: แนวคิด — สำรวจและกำหนดโจทย์

text.vi: Phỏng vấn những người trực tiếp làm việc, quan sát quy trình thực tế và rà soát dữ liệu đang có. Mục tiêu là tìm đúng điểm nghẽn, không phải danh sách mong muốn.
text.en: Interview the people doing the work, observe the real process and review existing data. The goal is to find the true bottleneck, not a wish list.
text.th: สัมภาษณ์ผู้ที่ทำงานจริง สังเกตกระบวนการจริง และทบทวนข้อมูลที่มีอยู่ เป้าหมายคือหาคอขวดที่แท้จริง ไม่ใช่รายการความต้องการ

text.vi: Đầu ra
text.th: ผลลัพธ์

text.vi: Bản đồ vấn đề, danh sách cơ hội xếp theo tác động và công sức
text.en: Problem map and opportunities ranked by impact and effort
text.th: แผนที่ปัญหาและรายการโอกาสที่จัดลำดับตามผลกระทบและความพยายาม

text.vi: Thời lượng gợi ý
text.th: ระยะเวลาโดยประมาณ

text.vi: 1–2 tuần
text.th: 1–2 สัปดาห์

text.vi: Thiết kế — quy trình mục tiêu và giải pháp
text.th: ออกแบบ — กระบวนการเป้าหมายและโซลูชัน

text.vi: Vẽ quy trình mục tiêu, mô hình dữ liệu và bản mẫu giao diện. Người dùng cuối được xem và góp ý ngay từ bản phác thảo.
text.en: Map the target process, data model and interface prototypes. End users review and comment from the first sketch.
text.th: ออกแบบกระบวนการเป้าหมาย โมเดลข้อมูล และต้นแบบหน้าจอ ผู้ใช้งานจริงได้ดูและให้ความเห็นตั้งแต่ร่างแรก

text.vi: Sơ đồ quy trình to-be, mô hình dữ liệu, mockup công cụ
text.en: To-be process maps, data model, tool mockups
text.th: แผนผังกระบวนการ to-be โมเดลข้อมูล และ mockup เครื่องมือ

text.vi: Thẩm định — chốt phạm vi, chi phí và KPI
text.en: Validation — agree on scope, cost and KPIs
text.th: ประเมิน — สรุปขอบเขต ค่าใช้จ่าย และ KPI

text.vi: Ban điều hành và đại diện người dùng cùng duyệt thiết kế. Đo số liệu nền (baseline) để có cơ sở so sánh sau triển khai.
text.en: Leadership and user representatives review the design together. We measure a baseline so results can be compared after rollout.
text.th: ผู้บริหารและตัวแทนผู้ใช้ร่วมกันพิจารณาการออกแบบ และวัดค่าฐาน (baseline) ไว้เปรียบเทียบหลังการใช้งานจริง

text.vi: Phạm vi đã chốt, KPI baseline, đánh giá rủi ro, quyết định go/no-go
text.en: Agreed scope, baseline KPIs, risk assessment, go/no-go decision
text.th: ขอบเขตที่สรุปแล้ว KPI ฐาน การประเมินความเสี่ยง และการตัดสินใจ go/no-go

text.vi: 3–5 ngày làm việc
text.th: 3–5 วันทำการ

text.vi: Phát triển — xây theo vòng ngắn
text.th: พัฒนา — สร้างเป็นรอบสั้น

text.vi: Làm theo vòng hai tuần, demo cuối mỗi vòng trên dữ liệu thật. Thay đổi được ghi nhận và ưu tiên lại công khai.
text.en: Work in two-week cycles with a demo on real data at the end of each. Changes are logged and reprioritized openly.
text.th: ทำงานเป็นรอบละสองสัปดาห์ และสาธิตกับข้อมูลจริงเมื่อจบแต่ละรอบ การเปลี่ยนแปลงถูกบันทึกและจัดลำดับใหม่อย่างโปร่งใส

text.vi: Dashboard, luồng tự động hoá, mô hình AI, SOP cập nhật
text.en: Dashboards, automation flows, AI models, updated SOPs
text.th: แดชบอร์ด โฟลว์อัตโนมัติ โมเดล AI และ SOP ที่อัปเดต

text.vi: 2–8 tuần
text.th: 2–8 สัปดาห์

text.vi: Kiểm thử — chạy song song với cách cũ
text.en: Testing — run in parallel with the old way
text.th: ทดสอบ — ใช้งานคู่ขนานกับวิธีเดิม

text.vi: Đối soát số liệu giữa hệ thống mới và cách làm hiện tại, kiểm tra phân quyền và các tình huống ngoại lệ trước khi chuyển đổi.
text.en: Reconcile numbers between the new system and the current way of working, and check permissions and edge cases before switching over.
text.th: กระทบยอดตัวเลขระหว่างระบบใหม่กับวิธีทำงานปัจจุบัน ตรวจสอบสิทธิ์การเข้าถึงและกรณียกเว้นก่อนเปลี่ยนระบบ

text.vi: Biên bản nghiệm thu (UAT), danh sách lỗi đã xử lý
text.en: UAT sign-off and resolved issue log
text.th: เอกสารรับรองผลการทดสอบ (UAT) และรายการปัญหาที่แก้ไขแล้ว

text.vi: Triển khai — chuyển đổi theo từng nhóm
text.en: Deployment — roll out team by team
text.th: ใช้งานจริง — ทยอยเปลี่ยนทีละกลุ่ม

text.vi: Đào tạo theo vai trò, chuyển đổi dần từng phòng ban và hỗ trợ sát trong tuần đầu. Mỗi hệ thống có người phụ trách nội bộ.
text.en: Role-based training, a gradual department-by-department switch and close support in the first week. Every system has an internal owner.
text.th: อบรมตามบทบาท ทยอยเปลี่ยนทีละแผนก และดูแลใกล้ชิดในสัปดาห์แรก ทุกระบบมีผู้รับผิดชอบภายในองค์กร

text.vi: Hệ thống chạy chính thức, tài liệu hướng dẫn, người phụ trách được đào tạo
text.en: Live system, user guides, trained internal owners
text.th: ระบบที่ใช้งานจริง คู่มือการใช้งาน และผู้รับผิดชอบที่ผ่านการอบรม

text.vi: Đánh giá lại — đo kết quả, mở vòng tiếp theo
text.en: Re-evaluation — measure results, start the next loop
text.th: ประเมินผลซ้ำ — วัดผลและเริ่มวงจรถัดไป

text.vi: Sau 30, 60 và 90 ngày, đo lại KPI so với baseline. Vấn đề mới phát sinh trở thành đầu vào cho bước Ý tưởng của vòng cải tiến kế tiếp.
text.en: After 30, 60 and 90 days, KPIs are measured again against the baseline. New issues become input for the Ideation step of the next improvement loop.
text.th: หลัง 30, 60 และ 90 วัน วัด KPI อีกครั้งเทียบกับค่าฐาน ปัญหาใหม่ที่เกิดขึ้นจะเป็นข้อมูลตั้งต้นของขั้นแนวคิดในวงจรปรับปรุงถัดไป

text.vi: Báo cáo hiệu quả so với baseline, backlog cải tiến vòng sau
text.en: Impact report against baseline, improvement backlog for the next loop
text.th: รายงานผลเทียบกับค่าฐาน และ backlog การปรับปรุงสำหรับวงจรถัดไป

text.vi: Mốc đánh giá
text.th: จุดวัดผล

text.vi: quay lại bước 01
text.th: กลับไปขั้นที่ 01

text.vi: Bước 07 nối về bước 01: chuyển đổi số là một vòng cải tiến liên tục, không phải dự án một lần.
text.en: Step 07 loops back to step 01: digital transformation is continuous improvement, not a one-off project.
text.th: ขั้นที่ 07 วนกลับไปขั้นที่ 01: การเปลี่ยนผ่านสู่ดิจิทัลคือการปรับปรุงอย่างต่อเนื่อง ไม่ใช่โครงการครั้งเดียว

text.th: รูปแบบความร่วมมือ

text.vi: Bắt đầu nhỏ, mở rộng khi đã thấy kết quả.
text.en: Start small. Scale once you see results.
text.th: เริ่มเล็ก แล้วขยายเมื่อเห็นผลลัพธ์

text.th: เริ่มต้น

text.th: 2 สัปดาห์

text.vi: Đánh giá hiện trạng quy trình và dữ liệu, chỉ ra ba cơ hội nên làm trước kèm ước tính công sức.
text.en: Assess current processes and data, and identify three opportunities to tackle first, with effort estimates.
text.th: ประเมินกระบวนการและข้อมูลปัจจุบัน พร้อมระบุสามโอกาสที่ควรทำก่อนและประมาณการความพยายาม

text.th: นิยมที่สุด

text.th: โครงการตามขอบเขต

text.th: 2–4 เดือน

text.vi: Đi đủ bảy bước cho một bài toán cụ thể, kèm đánh giá lại sau 30, 60 và 90 ngày vận hành.
text.en: All seven steps for one specific problem, with re-evaluation after 30, 60 and 90 days of operation.
text.th: ครบทั้งเจ็ดขั้นตอนสำหรับโจทย์เฉพาะหนึ่งเรื่อง พร้อมประเมินผลซ้ำหลังใช้งาน 30, 60 และ 90 วัน

text.th: ระยะยาว

text.vi: Đồng hành theo tháng
text.th: ร่วมงานรายเดือน

text.vi: Từ 3 tháng
text.th: ตั้งแต่ 3 เดือน

text.vi: Vai trò như một nhóm dữ liệu và vận hành thuê ngoài, ưu tiên lại công việc mỗi tháng.
text.en: We act as your outsourced data and operations team and reprioritize the work every month.
text.th: ทำหน้าที่เหมือนทีมข้อมูลและการดำเนินงานภายนอก และจัดลำดับงานใหม่ทุกเดือน

text.vi: Chi phí được báo theo phạm vi cụ thể sau buổi trao đổi đầu tiên.
text.en: Pricing is quoted per scope after our first conversation.
text.th: เสนอราคาตามขอบเขตงานหลังการพูดคุยครั้งแรก

text.vi: Những câu hỏi doanh nghiệp hay đặt ra trước khi bắt đầu.
text.en: Questions organizations often ask before getting started.
text.th: คำถามที่องค์กรมักถามก่อนเริ่มต้น

text.vi: Doanh nghiệp nhỏ có cần làm AI ngay không?
text.en: Does a small business need AI right away?
text.th: ธุรกิจขนาดเล็กจำเป็นต้องใช้ AI ทันทีหรือไม่

text.vi: Thường là chưa. Dữ liệu rõ ràng và quy trình được viết ra mang lại hiệu quả sớm hơn. AI phát huy tác dụng khi hai nền tảng này đã sẵn sàng.
text.en: Usually not yet. Clean data and written-down processes pay off sooner. AI delivers once those two foundations are in place.
text.th: โดยทั่วไปยังไม่จำเป็น ข้อมูลที่ชัดเจนและกระบวนการที่เขียนไว้ให้ผลเร็วกว่า AI จะได้ผลเต็มที่เมื่อรากฐานทั้งสองนี้พร้อมแล้ว

text.vi: Có bắt buộc mua phần mềm mới không?
text.en: Do we have to buy new software?
text.th: ต้องซื้อซอฟต์แวร์ใหม่หรือไม่

text.vi: Không. Chúng tôi ưu tiên tận dụng công cụ doanh nghiệp đang dùng như Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Excel hay phần mềm kế toán, và chỉ đề xuất công cụ mới khi có lý do rõ ràng.
text.en: No. We make the most of the tools you already use, such as Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Excel or your accounting software, and only recommend new tools when there is a clear reason.
text.th: ไม่จำเป็น เราเน้นใช้เครื่องมือที่องค์กรมีอยู่แล้ว เช่น Google Workspace, Microsoft 365, Excel หรือซอฟต์แวร์บัญชี และจะแนะนำเครื่องมือใหม่เมื่อมีเหตุผลชัดเจนเท่านั้น

text.vi: Dữ liệu của doanh nghiệp được bảo mật thế nào?
text.en: How is our data kept secure?
text.th: ข้อมูลขององค์กรได้รับการปกป้องอย่างไร

text.vi: Ký thoả thuận bảo mật trước khi tiếp cận dữ liệu, cấp quyền ở mức tối thiểu cần thiết, không dùng dữ liệu của khách hàng để huấn luyện mô hình bên ngoài và tuân thủ quy định pháp luật Việt Nam về bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân.
text.en: We sign a confidentiality agreement before accessing any data, grant only the minimum access needed, never use client data to train external models, and comply with applicable personal data protection laws.

Cách MindKite Labs thu thập, sử dụng và bảo vệ thông tin cá nhân.
text.en: How MindKite Labs collects, uses and protects personal information.

text.vi: Điều khoản sử dụng website mindkitelabs.com.
text.en: Terms of use for the mindkitelabs.com website.

text.vi: Trang chủ
Cập nhật lần cuối: 10/10/2026

MindKite Labs là tên thương mại do nhóm sáng lập vận hành, hiện đang trong quá trình đăng ký doanh nghiệp. Chính sách này mô tả cách chúng tôi thu thập, sử dụng và bảo vệ thông tin cá nhân khi bạn truy cập mindkitelabs.com hoặc liên hệ với chúng tôi.
text.en: MindKite Labs is a trade name operated by its founding team and is currently in the process of company registration. This policy describes how we collect, use and protect personal information when you visit mindkitelabs.com or contact us.

text.vi: 1. Thông tin chúng tôi thu thập
Thông tin bạn chủ động gửi:
họ tên, email, số điện thoại, tên doanh nghiệp và nội dung trao đổi khi bạn gửi email cho chúng tôi.
text.en: your name, email, phone number, organization name and the content of your message when you email us.

text.vi: Thông tin kỹ thuật:

website không sử dụng cookie theo dõi, công cụ phân tích hay quảng cáo. Website được lưu trữ trên GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., Hoa Kỳ) và tải phông chữ từ Google Fonts (Google LLC); hai dịch vụ này nhận địa chỉ IP và thông tin trình duyệt của bạn khi trang được tải, theo chính sách riêng của họ.
text.en: this website does not use tracking cookies, analytics or advertising tools. It is hosted on GitHub Pages (GitHub, Inc., United States) and loads fonts from Google Fonts (Google LLC); these two services receive your IP address and browser information when the page loads, under their own policies.

text.vi: 2. Mục đích sử dụng
Phản hồi yêu cầu tư vấn và trao đổi về dịch vụ.
text.en: To respond to consulting inquiries and discuss our services.

text.vi: Chuẩn bị đề xuất, hợp đồng khi hai bên đồng ý hợp tác.
text.en: To prepare proposals and contracts when both parties agree to work together.

text.vi: Thực hiện nghĩa vụ theo quy định pháp luật.
Chúng tôi không bán, cho thuê hoặc trao đổi thông tin cá nhân của bạn cho bên thứ ba vì mục đích tiếp thị.
text.en: We do not sell, rent or trade your personal information to third parties for marketing purposes.

text.vi: 3. Chia sẻ thông tin

Thông tin chỉ được chia sẻ với nhà cung cấp dịch vụ cần thiết để vận hành (dịch vụ email Google Workspace, lưu trữ website GitHub Pages, phông chữ Google Fonts), hoặc khi cơ quan nhà nước có thẩm quyền yêu cầu theo quy định pháp luật. Một số nhà cung cấp này đặt máy chủ ở nước ngoài, nên dữ liệu có thể được chuyển ra ngoài lãnh thổ Việt Nam.
text.en: Information is shared only with service providers we need to operate (Google Workspace email, GitHub Pages hosting, Google Fonts), or when a competent authority requires it by law. Some of these providers operate servers abroad, so data may be transferred outside Vietnam.

text.vi: 4. Dữ liệu của khách hàng trong dự án

Với dữ liệu doanh nghiệp được cung cấp trong quá trình tư vấn, chúng tôi ký thoả thuận bảo mật trước khi tiếp cận, chỉ truy cập ở mức tối thiểu cần thiết, không dùng dữ liệu đó để huấn luyện mô hình AI bên ngoài và xoá hoặc hoàn trả dữ liệu khi kết thúc hợp đồng theo thoả thuận.
text.en: For organizational data provided during an engagement, we sign a confidentiality agreement before access, use only the minimum access needed, do not use that data to train external AI models, and delete or return the data at the end of the contract as agreed.

text.vi: 5. Thời gian lưu trữ
Thông tin liên hệ được lưu trong thời gian cần thiết cho mục đích nêu trên, hoặc lâu hơn nếu pháp luật yêu cầu.
text.en: Contact information is kept for as long as needed for the purposes above, or longer if required by law.

text.vi: 6. Quyền của bạn

Bạn có quyền yêu cầu xem, chỉnh sửa, xoá thông tin cá nhân hoặc rút lại sự đồng ý xử lý dữ liệu, theo quy định pháp luật Việt Nam về bảo vệ dữ liệu cá nhân. Gửi yêu cầu tới email bên dưới, chúng tôi phản hồi trong thời hạn luật định.
text.en: You may request access to, correction or deletion of your personal information, or withdraw your consent to processing, in accordance with Vietnamese personal data protection law. Send your request to the email below and we will respond within the statutory time limit.

text.vi: 7. Bảo mật
Website được phục vụ qua HTTPS. Không có phương thức truyền tải nào an toàn tuyệt đối, nhưng chúng tôi áp dụng các biện pháp hợp lý để bảo vệ thông tin.
text.en: This website is served over HTTPS. No method of transmission is completely secure, but we take reasonable measures to protect your information.

text.vi: 8. Thay đổi chính sách
Chúng tôi có thể cập nhật chính sách này. Ngày cập nhật lần cuối được ghi ở đầu trang.
text.en: We may update this policy. The date of the latest update is shown at the top of this page.

Khi truy cập mindkitelabs.com, bạn đồng ý với các điều khoản dưới đây.
text.en: By using mindkitelabs.com, you agree to the terms below.
